game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the cave gate fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 7: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Characteristics and limits.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: size drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
